problem_statement: The cross-model HTML is valid, verified and present in the immutable public workspace, but a consumer opening index.html cannot reach it through a dedicated primary product card. Changing the v1.8.0 index unconditionally would alter the already audited deterministic index for an immutable historical release.

selection_policy.decision_rule: Select the highest weighted option that makes the published product discoverable without changing the audited v1.8.0 workspace, comparison semantics or source-backed data.

options.name: Version-Gated Cross-Model Primary Card
options.decision: Add a fifth Start here card that links to contents/cross-model/cross-model-comparison-view.html only for release versions 1.8.1 and later. Preserve byte-identical v1.8.0 index generation and its 83-link audit contract.

options.name: Documentation-Only Discovery
options.rejection_reason: README and release notes already describe the product, but users entering through the offline workspace still lack a direct product card. Documentation alone does not solve local discoverability.

options.name: Change the v1.8.0 Index In Place
options.rejection_reason: An unconditional card would change the audited v1.8.0 index hash and local-link count, causing old verified workspaces to differ from later downloads of the same immutable release.

options.name: Interactive Workspace Search and Filtering
options.decision: Search and filtering may be useful later, but adding JavaScript and a new interaction model is unnecessary for exposing one existing product and exceeds the current usability correction.

selection.name: Version-Gated Cross-Model Primary Card
selection.rationale: The workspace index already validates every release member and has the release version available during rendering. A version-gated primary card reuses the verified-content path contract, gives immediate local access to the published cross-model HTML and preserves historical v1.8.0 bytes by introducing the card only in a patch release.

implementation_contract.card_description: Browse five model families and launch only existing scope-safe comparisons.
required_behavior: validate the cross-model HTML against the release manifest before linking
require the local file to exist in the extracted workspace
preserve the exact v1.8.0 index output
add exactly one primary local link for v1.8.1 and later
keep comparison-scope links and asset links unchanged
keep the index static and JavaScript-free

next_package.name: Cross-Model Workspace Index Entry
next_package.goal: Implement and test a version-gated fifth workspace-index card for releases 1.8.1 and later while reproducing the exact audited v1.8.0 index and changing no release data or comparison semantics.
